crossRefs.note: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don’t argue about words, to no profit…
But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God’s stewardship, which…
But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy…
constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain.…
but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

translations.web: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
translations.bsb: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
translations.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
translations.asv: But foolish and ignorant questionings refuse, knowing that they gender strifes.
